name: Granola
summary: Ask about your Granola meetings: recent meetings, notes, transcripts and search, via Composio.
description: Read your Granola meeting notes and transcripts by voice, list recent meetings, and ask questions across them. Runs through Composio, so the integration never handles your Granola sign-in.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: API key from your Composio dashboard (Settings, API Keys). Needs session and connected-account access.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_AUTH_CONFIG_ID
preferences.title: Auth config ID
preferences.description: ID (ac_...) of your Granola MCP auth config in the Composio dashboard, set to Dynamic Client Registration.

tools.name: list_recent_meetings
tools.title: List recent meetings
tools.description: List the user's Granola meetings with their IDs, titles, dates and participants, newest first. Use when the user asks what meetings they had, wants to pick a meeting, or you need a meeting ID for get_meeting_notes or get_transcript. Defaults to the last 30 days.

time_range.description: this_week, last_week, last_30_days (default) or custom. Custom needs start_date and end_date.

start_date.description: First day of a custom range, as YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: Last day of a custom range, as YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: get_meeting_notes
tools.title: Get meeting notes
tools.description: Get Granola's notes for specific meetings: the AI summary, the user's own notes, participants and date. Use when the user asks for a meeting's notes, summary, decisions or action items and you have its ID from list_recent_meetings or search_meetings. Takes up to 10 meeting IDs.

meeting_ids.description: Granola meeting IDs (UUIDs) from list_recent_meetings or search_meetings, up to 10

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: Get the word-for-word transcript of one Granola meeting. Use only when the user wants exact wording or what someone literally said; for summaries use get_meeting_notes or search_meetings. Needs a meeting ID from list_recent_meetings or search_meetings. Very long transcripts are cut short.

meeting_id.description: Granola meeting ID (UUID) from list_recent_meetings or search_meetings

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.title: Search meetings
tools.description: Ask Granola a question about the user's meetings and get an answer with numbered citations to the meetings it came from. Use for open questions such as what was decided, who owns an action item, or what was said about a topic. The cited meeting IDs come back in sources. Takes about 10 seconds.

query.description: The question or topic, in the user's words

meeting_ids.description: Optional meeting IDs (UUIDs) to limit the search to

tools.name: connect_account
tools.title: Connect Granola
tools.description: Connect the user's Granola account by signing in through Composio in the browser. Use when the user asks to connect, link, or sign in to Granola, or after a Granola tool says the connection is missing or expired. If Granola is already connected, it only verifies that.

children.text: Continue in your browser to sign in to Granola. If you're already connected, this only checks the connection.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.title: Granola account
tools.description: Show whether Granola is connected, with Connect, Disconnect and Refresh controls. Use when the user asks about their Granola account, connection status, or an expired or revoked sign-in. Read only: it never starts a sign-in.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.title: Disconnect Granola
tools.description: Disconnect the user's Granola account: revokes access where Composio supports it and removes the connection. Use only when the user explicitly asks to disconnect, unlink or sign out of Granola. Never changes anything in Granola.

children.text: VoiceOS will lose access to your Granola meetings until you connect again.
Your notes and transcripts in Granola stay as they are.

blocks.text: Save your setup fields. Say “connect Granola” to sign in from your browser, “show my Granola connection” for Connect and Disconnect controls, or “disconnect Granola” to unlink your account.
